title: Decent ceramic burr style, could be better
text:
Decent ceramic burr style, could be better. After reading a lot about burr grinders, I was excited to give this a try. However, with no prior experience, I found the lack of proper instructions to be very frustrating. It comes with a paper booklet but it is written very poorly and does not at all make it clear how this is supposed to work. Thankfully, I found someone on youtube demonstrating a product that looked almost identical. The top of the unit opens up around were the handle attaches, and beans can be put inside. The bottom half (with the window) holds the ground beans, which can then be poured easily into the filter for brewing. In between those is the ceramic grinding parts, with a knob that can be adjust to make it more fine or more coarse. This in particular was very unclear in the instructions, as it almost sounded like turning the crank clockwise or counter clockwise would effect the grind, but it mean this adjustment gear.
While loosening the adjustment gear to see how coarse it can go, it actually popped off and the entire assembly sprang out into a few different pieces (thanks to a tension spring that is supposed to hold it all into place. I managed to get everything back together to a point that it seems to work, but once again, the instructions did not warn me not to turn it too far, and it really could have come with a diagram or something to reassemble it as I'm still not 100% it was assembled properly again after that.
Bottom line is: It works. But it is NOT beginner friendly at all.
